original_title: Fortnite Live Event Stuns Fans as The Rock's Fate Is Revealed and Ben Starr's Character Is Unmasked in Shock Twist

en.title: Fortnite's The Foundation Frozen as The Rock's Character Suffers Shock Defeat
en.summary: Fortnite's latest live event, 'Shattered,' delivered a dramatic conclusion to its season, seeing Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson's character, The Foundation, defeated and frozen. The event also unmasked a key ally, revealing a surprising twist for players.
en.body:
Fortnite's immersive world just experienced a seismic shift with the conclusion of its latest live event, 'Shattered.' This climactic showdown, the culmination of a season-long rivalry, saw players witness the dramatic defeat of **Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson's** heroic character, **The Foundation**. The event's narrative branched based on player choices throughout the season, offering two distinct perspectives. Those who sided with **The Foundation** found themselves in a bunker alongside **Jonesy** and **The Visitor**, voiced by **Ben Starr**, gathering intel for the mission. Conversely, players who backed **The Ice King** received insight into his wintry domain and his allegiance to the season's primary antagonist, **The Dark Voyager**.

As both factions converged, a brief player-vs-player skirmish ensued, but the true spectacle was the head-on collision between **The Foundation** and **The Ice King**. Players could follow this epic clash up close as the two titans tore through the Fortnite Island. Ultimately, **The Foundation** was overcome, regardless of player allegiance, and met a chilling fate: frozen solid with his ultimate destiny left hanging in the balance. The **Ice King**, however, did not escape unscathed, falling victim to a betrayal by **The Dark Voyager**, who seemingly disintegrated him.

## The Visitor's Identity Revealed

The 'Shattered' event also delivered a significant narrative bombshell with the unmasking of **The Visitor**, a crucial ally to **The Foundation**. Voiced by **Ben Starr**, known for his work in titles like *Final Fantasy VII Remake* and *Genshin Impact*, **The Visitor** was revealed to be more than just a helpful companion. This unmasking adds a new layer of mystery to the ongoing Fortnite saga, prompting speculation about his true motivations and his role in the larger narrative tapestry woven by Epic Games. The dual narrative paths ensured that every player's experience felt personal, culminating in a shared, yet uniquely perceived, dramatic conclusion.

## What This Means for the Island and Its Players

This event's outcome is a stark reminder of Fortnite's dynamic storytelling. The defeat and uncertain fate of **The Foundation**, a character central to recent storylines and voiced by a global superstar, sends ripples through the player base. The unmasking of **The Visitor** further fuels community discussions and theories about the future direction of the game's lore. For a community that thrives on deciphering clues and anticipating the next major plot point, 'Shattered' has provided ample material for speculation and excitement, reinforcing Fortnite's status as a platform for evolving, interactive narratives.

## What's Next

Following the downtime after 'Shattered,' players can expect the start of a new season. Details regarding the specific content, storyline continuation, and any new characters or mechanics have not yet been announced, but the stage is set for a fresh chapter in Fortnite's ever-expanding universe.

tr.title: Fortnite'nin The Foundation'u Donduruldu: The Rock'un Karakteri Şok Edici Defa Etti
tr.summary: Fortnite'nin son canlı olayı, 'Shattered', sezonun dramatik sonunu gördü, Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson'un karakteri, The Foundation, yenildi ve donduruldu. Olay aynı zamanda bir anahtar müttefikin maskesini düşürdü, oyunculara şaşırtıcı bir dönemece işaret etti.
tr.body:
Fortnite'nin etkileyici dünyası, son canlı olayı 'Shattered' ile son buldu. Bu dramatik karşılaşma, sezon boyunca süren rekabetin doruk noktasıydı. Oyuncular, The Foundation'un yenilgisini ve şok edici bir kaderi gördü. Olayın anlatısı, sezon boyunca oyuncuların seçimleri doğrultusunda değişti, iki farklı perspektif sunuldu. The Foundation'a sadık kalan oyuncular, Jonesy ve The Visitor ile birlikte bir sığınakta toplanarak planlarını hazırladılar. Diğer yandan, The Ice King'e sadık kalan oyuncular, dondurucu domainine ve sezonun ana antagonistine olan bağlılığını keşfetti.

Kolayca bir oyunculara karşı oyuncular arasında çatışmadan sonra, gerçek gösteri, The Foundation ve The Ice King'in head-on çarpışmasıydı. Oyuncular bu epik karşılaşmayı yakından izleyebildiler. Sonunda, The Foundation yenildi ve donduruldu. The Ice King ise, The Dark Voyager tarafından bir ihanetle yenildi ve yok edildi.

## The Visitor'ın Gerçek Kimliği Açıklandı

'Şattered' olayı, The Visitor'ın maskesini düşürerek önemli bir hikaye bombası patlatdı. The Foundation'un önemli bir müttefiki olan The Visitor'ın, sadece yardımcı bir karakter olmadığını ortaya çıkardı. Bu maskenin düşürülmesi, Fortnite'nun devam eden hikayesinde yeni bir katman ekledi ve oyuncuların gerçek motivasyonlarını ve rolünü anlamaya çalışmasına neden oldu. Oyuncuların her birinin deneyiminden bağımsız olarak, her oyuncunun kendi hikayesini hissettirmek için dual anlatı yolları sunuldu.

## Bu Ne Anlama Geliyor?

Bu olayın sonucu, Fortnite'nun dinamik hikaye anlatımını hatırlatıyor. The Foundation'un yenilmesi ve belirsiz kaderi, oyuncuların tepkisine neden oldu. The Visitor'ın maskesinin düşürülmesi, oyuncuların gelecekteki hikaye yönünü tartışmasına ve teoriler geliştirmesine neden oldu. Oyuncuların, hikaye içindeki ipuçlarını çözme ve gelecek büyük olayı beklemeye alışkın olduğu bir topluluk, 'Shattered' olayı, Fortnite'nun hikaye anlatımının canlı, etkileşimli bir platform olduğunu teyit etti.

## Ne İyice?

'Şattered' olayından sonra, oyuncular, yeni bir sezonun başlangıcını bekleyebilir. Detaylar, içerik, hikaye devamı ve yeni karakterler veya mekanikler hakkında henüz açıklanmadı, ancak yeni bir bölümün başlangıcının hazırlıkları tamamlanmıştır.

es.title: Fortnite: La Fundación congelada en una sorprendente derrota para The Rock
es.summary: El evento 'Shattered' de Fortnite ha llevado a un giro dramático en la temporada, con la derrota y congelación de The Foundation, personaje de Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson. Además, se desveló un aliado clave, revelando una sorprendente vuelta de tuerca para los jugadores.
es.body:
La realidad inmersiva de Fortnite experimentó un cambio seismico con la conclusión del evento 'Shattered', el punto culminante de una temporada de rivalidad que llevó a los jugadores a presenciar la dramática derrota de **Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson** en su personaje heroico, **La Fundación**. El evento tuvo dos narrativas distintas según las elecciones de los jugadores a lo largo de la temporada. Aquellos que se unieron a **La Fundación** se encontraron en un refugio junto a **Jonesy** y **El Visitante**, interpretado por **Ben Starr**, recopilando inteligencia para la misión. Por otro lado, los jugadores que apoyaron al **Rey del Hielo** recibieron información sobre su dominio invernal y su lealtad al antagonista principal de la temporada, **El Viajero Oscuro**.


Cuando las dos facciones se encontraron, se produjo un breve enfrentamiento entre jugadores, pero el verdadero espectáculo fue la colisión frontal entre **La Fundación** y **El Rey del Hielo**. Los jugadores pudieron seguir esta épica batalla de cerca mientras los dos titanes se desgarraban por la Isla de Fortnite. Finalmente, **La Fundación** fue derrotado, independientemente de la lealtad del jugador, y se encontró con un destino congelado, dejando su destino final en suspenso. **El Rey del Hielo**, sin embargo, no escapó indemne, siendo víctima de una traición por parte de **El Viajero Oscuro**, quien lo desintegró.

## El desenmascaramiento de El Visitante

El evento 'Shattered' también entregó un bombazo narrativo significativo con el desenmascaramiento de **El Visitante**, un aliado crucial para **La Fundación**. Interpretado por **Ben Starr**, conocido por su trabajo en títulos como *Final Fantasy VII Remake* y *Genshin Impact*, **El Visitante** se reveló ser más que un compañero útil. Este desenmascaramiento añadió una nueva capa de misterio a la saga de Fortnite en curso, generando especulaciones sobre sus verdaderas motivaciones y su papel en la narrativa más amplia tejida por Epic Games. Las dos narrativas paralelas aseguraron que cada experiencia de los jugadores se sintiera personal, culminando en una conclusión dramática compartida, pero única.

## Las implicaciones para la Isla y sus jugadores

Este resultado del evento es un recordatorio claro de la narrativa dinámica de Fortnite. La derrota y el destino incierto de **La Fundación**, un personaje central en las últimas historias y interpretado por un estrella global, envía ondas de choque a través de la base de jugadores. El desenmascaramiento de **El Visitante** alimenta aún más las discusiones y teorías de la comunidad sobre la dirección futura de la narrativa del juego. Para una comunidad que se nutre de descifrar pistas y anticipar el próximo punto de la trama, 'Shattered' ha proporcionado material abundante para la especulación y la emoción, reforzando el estatus de Fortnite como plataforma para narrativas interactivas en evolución.

## Próximos Pasos

Después del tiempo de inactividad después de 'Shattered', los jugadores pueden esperar el comienzo de una nueva temporada. Los detalles sobre el contenido específico, la continuación de la trama, nuevos personajes y mecánicas aún no han sido anunciados, pero el escenario está dispuesto para un nuevo capítulo en el universo en constante expansión de Fortnite.

content_raw: Fortnite has just concluded a stunning live event that saw the game's storyline propelled forward in dramatic style, with a shock defeat for Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson's heroic character, and an eye-popping unmasking of his ally played by Ben Starr. Epic Games' battle royale is now in downtime following the events of Shattered, the long-awaited conclusion to its latest season that saw players decide the fate of a months-long grudge match between Johnson's The Foundation and his frosty rival The Ice King. Shattered was unique as it offered two entirely separate narrative viewpoints from which to view its events, depending on whether you'd previously backed The Foundation or The Ice King over the course of the season. Players who backed The Foundation began the event in a bunker with trusty ally The Visitor (played by Clair Obscur's Ben Starr) and long-time Fortnite protagonist Jonesy, picking up banter and clues to the mission ahead. Players who picked The Ice King, meanwhile, got a glimpse into his wintry fortress, and learned more about his mission to serve the game's current major antagonist, The Dark Voyager. As the two teams moved against each other, players briefly came into combat — though the fireworks were truly reserved for the showdown between The Foundation and The Ice King themselves, which players could follow close-up as they smashed up each other and huge chunks of the Fortnite battle royal Island. Ultimately, The Foundation lost — regardless of team, players were informed on screen that the overall winner of the season was not the former WWE star — and because of that, players saw him frozen solid, his ultimate fate left uncertain. The Ice King fared no better in the end, however, as he was double-crossed by The Dark Voyager, and seemingly reduced to atoms. It's interesting to ponder how the pair might have fared if players picked The Foundation to win. Would their fates have been similar, somehow? Either way, both characters have been taken off the board, for now. Shattered concluded with players witnessing Fortnite's long-term macguffin, the Zero Point, reforged just in time to completely revamp the game's map — a mid-year refresh of a kind never seen in Fortnite before. Narratively, it's a cool idea and fitting with the Zero Point's return. Mechanically, it's also a sign Epic Games may be keen to keep its game feeling fresher than ever as player numbers decline. But the most shocking part of the event was still to come, as Jonesy reflected on its events and realized something fishy was going on... only for trusty ally The Visitor to remove his helmet and reveal himself to actually be Geno — the ultimate villain of Fortnite never properly glimpsed in-game before, but teased in other live events and depicted in spinoff comic books. Geno is a figure that fans have wanted to finally see since his name was initially referenced five years ago.
